name: Launchpad Product
description: A product changelog with dates in a left gutter on the rail, covers under each title and a side column on every release page.
modelledOn: A SaaS product changelog with a dated rail
features: The `product` changelog look — a patch of independent `theme.changelog` keys, so any key you set still wins
Change types New, Improved, Fixed, Deprecated, Retired, Security with their tone colours
"Latest" chip on the newest stable release, pre-releases on their own channel
Was-this-helpful under every release, answers in Studio → Readers
Subscribe box under every release; RSS, Atom and JSON feeds
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

attrs.heading: Get every release by email
attrs.body: One short email when something ships.

posts.title: Dark mode, everywhere
posts.markdown:
Every screen now follows your system theme, and you can pin light or dark in Settings.

## Added

- A theme switch under Settings → Appearance.
- Dark variants of every chart.

posts.title: API v1 is retired
posts.markdown:
Requests to v1 now answer 410. Every v1 call has a v2 twin.

## Removed

- `/v1/*` endpoints.

## Upgrading

Move to `/v2`; the migration guide maps each call.
